core.note: The broker holds roughly 4-8.5% extra cash on market buys (seen 13 Oct 2026), so a buy uses cash/(1+buy_reserve) and the rest follows in a later buy.

satellite.rationale: Decisions C2 and C6 (CEO mandate, 26 Oct 2026): 80% VWRP core. The passive picks are held at 15% of the book, trimmed pro rata with no validated ranking, and a pick worth under £2 after the trim is sold in full. The other 5% is cash for the active sleeve. No company may exceed 5% of the book.

active.rationale: Decision C6: the 20% satellite trades short-term to learn quickly and cheaply which ideas work. No edge is proven; the kill rule switches off any strategy that does not beat VWRP after 30 trades. Long only: no leverage, CFDs or shorting. Forward data only.

drop_rebound.rule: a watchlist name down 5% or more on the day: buy 2% of the book, expecting a partial rebound

breakout_momentum.rule: a watchlist name up 5% or more on the day: buy 2% of the book, expecting continuation
